Stage: (1) /scan was not recorded, so (a) is a lower bound and the reduction factors are conservative.
(2) /spi_log events are counted at the threshold without tolerance (the monitor's online behaviour).
(3) (c) → (d) is not a volume reduction but a semantic step from events to claim status: a row is written per run and claim even without events.
Data volume: serialized message size (a)–(c), CSV size (d)–(e); decimal units (kB = 1000 B, MB = 10^6 B). Reduction factors refer to data volume.
Monitor efficiency (replay of 12 bags, 5,048 check cycles at 20 Hz): processing time per check cycle mean 0.26 ms, p95 0.45 ms (worst bag), max 1.51 ms, i.e. at most 3 % of the 50 ms cycle.
